references.text: Similar instructions are given to buy food and water from Edom and Moab, showing God's command for peaceful trade with neighboring peoples.
Israel asks to be allowed to buy water from Edom, reflecting the same principle of paying for food and water during the journey.
Israel sends a message to Sihon with an offer to pay for food and water, in line with the instruction in Deuteronomy.
Jacob bought a plot of land for money, an example of fair trade with other peoples in the land.
Jesus says that the worker is worthy of his food, a principle of fair payment reflected in paying for food and water.
